dedupe_keys.name: rskgd fl 2014 2018 a five year florida temporal road safety knowledge graph dataset and benchmark

description: The RSKGD research team publishes Florida crash records linked to annual road-segment inventories for 2014–2018. Zenodo exposes a ZIP containing layered tables, schemas and provenance under repository CC BY 4.0 metadata, with component-specific licence conditions retained inside the package. The description reports 2,077,333 canonical FDOT crash events and annual TIGER road universes, including segments with no matched crashes. Candidate, selected and unmatched associations distinguish the stages of spatial linkage. These records can calibrate road-event and exposure components in transport simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this derived release. Coverage is Florida and the stated years, not a national safety inventory. A limitation is that algorithmic associations are not ground-truth locations; absent traffic denominators also prevent interpreting counts as accident rates. No archive was downloaded or linkage accuracy checked.
